scope: All bundled localized installed Global skill definitions, including inherited and event-only records. Declaration/formula coverage; not achieved per-race coverage.

master.name: Local Global master SQLite public metadata
master.license: Game metadata © the UM:PD rights holders
master.notes: Independently selected public metadata columns; no user/account data or artwork.

simulator.qualification: Independent reference implementation; not native runtime call trace.

fallbackCoverage.precedence: Primary definition wins; fallback supplies missing IDs.

methodology.formula: Separate semantic/formula understanding from implemented replay metric and required observations.
methodology.directEncoding: Direct value encoding support describes the current value normalizer only; it does not establish effect semantics or per-race magnitude for unknown/event-only types.
methodology.branchCandidates: A formula-candidate branch uses only 9/21/22/27/31 with direct magnitudes; its duration, level, target, samples, immunity and mechanics context can still be unknown.
methodology.initialContext: Initial passive/stat/vision/style inputs are modelled elsewhere, not per-skill race effectiveness.
methodology.applicability: Positive target-speed score uses zero/half/full credited time by user convention; acceleration and direct-speed rows retain separate applicability metrics. None is exact causal race gain.
methodology.causality: No universal percentage or exact finish gain is identifiable for every skill. Type-specific model metrics and partial/unknown coverage remain separate. Do not sum overlapping nonlinear marginal effects.
methodology.unsupported: All unknown codes are retained with unverified/unsupported state. No missing formula becomes zero effectiveness.

calculation.name: Speed stat
calculation.semantics: Add to adjusted speed.
formulas: Adjusted stat += resolved magnitude; late target speed stat term sqrt(500×finalSpeed)×0.002×distanceAptitudeMultiplier.
calculation.metric: Initial stat gain; conditional target-speed change.
limitations: Only the stat-dependent target term is specified here, not the full target formula.
Per-skill stat and target coefficients are conditional component metrics, not finish gain.
Hidden target and field feedback prevent exact finish gain.

calculation.name: Stamina stat
calculation.semantics: Add to final stamina for the reference HP calculation.
calculation.metric: Initial stat gain and maximum HP contribution; reference spurt budget.
limitations: The inspected solver separately mutates raw-stamina bookkeeping; this is not a second HP contribution.
Individual starting-HP coefficients hold other resolved inputs fixed.
Drain and selected spurt target/roll may be unknown.

calculation.name: Power stat
calculation.semantics: Add to adjusted power.
calculation.metric: Initial stat gain, reference acceleration and uphill comparison.
limitations: Per-skill initial acceleration and per-grade uphill coefficients hold other inputs fixed.
Cap/block/lane feedback changes realized race benefit.

calculation.name: Guts stat
calculation.semantics: Add to adjusted guts.
formulas: Spurt/dueling/late HP coefficients use adjusted guts.
calculation.metric: Initial stat gain and conditional speed/HP coefficients.
limitations: Per-skill minimum-speed and equal-self-speed HP-drain coefficients are conditional.
Selected spurt/dueling trajectory is incompletely observed.

calculation.name: Wit stat
calculation.semantics: Add adjusted wit; skill activation lottery uses pre-skill base wit.
formulas: Section target upper offset %=wit/5500×log10(0.1×wit); uniform spread0.65percentage points.
calculation.metric: Initial stat gain and reference section/status probability changes.
limitations: No causal distance from averaging24 unobserved rolls.
A wit passive does not improve already-pre-rolled skill lottery.

evidence.locator: Randomness Per Section; Skill Activation Chance; Rushed

calculation.name: Runaway
calculation.semantics: Convert eligible Front Runner to Runaway strategy.
calculation.metric: Resolved strategy context; no universal utility percentage.
limitations: Alternate pacemaker and field responses are not observed.

evidence.source: Bundled installed Global master skill_data and text_data categories47/48

calculation.name: Vision
calculation.semantics: Modify forward vision distance.
calculation.metric: Per-skill reference vision metres; no causal lane/target benefit.
limitations: Component metrics expose magnitude; replay draws reference visibility context.
Geometric candidates do not establish skill hits or lane decisions.

calculation.name: Instant HP
calculation.semantics: Instant fraction of maximum HP; negative values remove HP.
calculation.metric: HP capacity efficiency/overcap, conditional amount and spurt budget/timing.
limitations: Sparse pre-event HP and shared brackets may leave clamp unknown.
HP efficiency is not overall race utility.

calculation.name: Start-delay multiplier
calculation.semantics: Multiply the random gate delay once.
calculation.metric: Saved delay where the full multiplier composition is uniquely invertible.
limitations: Per-skill saved delay is conditional on complete invertible gate composition.
Multiple effects/overrides can erase the original random delay.

calculation.name: Rushed extension
calculation.semantics: Reset the ongoing rushed calm-down timer for selected rivals.
formulas: Installed Global Frenzied raw50000 denotes reference5s reset timer, not additive5s.
calculation.metric: Recorded recipients/rushed overlap and declared extension seconds.
limitations: Hidden calm-down timer/roll prevents causal extra-rushed duration.
Declared reset seconds and recorded episode overlap do not recover unextended calm-down rolls.

evidence.source: Bundled installed Global master skill_data and text_data categories47/48

calculation.name: Start-delay override
calculation.semantics: Set the gate delay once.
calculation.metric: Captured override and possible saved-delay bounds.
limitations: Original gate roll is not recoverable from the override alone.
Override seconds are exposed; original gate draw and gain remain unidentified.

calculation.name: Direct speed
calculation.semantics: Add after self-speed acceleration; HP drain uses self speed.
calculation.metric: Active direct distance, equivalent local time, separate recipients/immunity.
limitations: Conditional local attribution, not resimulated finish-time gain.

calculation.name: Direct speed with natural deceleration
calculation.semantics: Direct actual-speed bonus; equal self-speed impulse on expiry.
formulas: On expiry SelfSpeed +=modifier, then reference acceleration/deceleration.
calculation.metric: Direct active contribution plus separate bounded carryover.
limitations: Carryover depends on unreported target and overlapping effects.

calculation.name: Target speed
calculation.semantics: Add to self-speed target.
formulas: User-selected positive-speed score: blocked/below normal0; accelerating normal→boosted target0.5; reached boosted target1.
calculation.metric: Half-credit speed score and separate conditional distance/time/HP impact.
requirements: Normal target without selected bonus, including other known effects
limitations: This score is a convention, not exact causal effectiveness.
Unreported target ranges leave boundary time unknown.
Never equate declared bonus with instant actual-speed increase.

calculation.name: Lane speed
calculation.semantics: Add lateral actual-speed modifier; inspected simulator has conditional forward coupling.
calculation.metric: Resolved lateral modifier and complete sampled lane travel; no causal forward gain.
limitations: Current target lane/side-block intent absent.
Unknown coupling remains excluded from exact forward attribution.

calculation.name: Rushed chance
calculation.semantics: Reduce probability of becoming rushed.
formulas: Restraint has flat−3percentage points after reference wit-derived chance, floor0.
calculation.metric: Declared/reference chance difference.
limitations: Individual prevention cannot be proved by absence of a rushed event.
Per-skill probability modifier is separate from realized prevention.

evidence.source: Bundled installed Global master skill_data and text_data categories47/48

calculation.name: Acceleration
calculation.semantics: Add acceleration while self speed is below its supported target/cap.
formulas: Cap-crossing fraction =(cap−entrySelf)/(base+allResolvedAccel), when trajectory/plateau supports it.
calculation.metric: Separate useful/capped/blocked/unknown seconds and conditional local gain.
limitations: Cannot call all non-late acceleration wasted.
A speed component in a mixed skill does not make acceleration useful.

calculation.name: Lane change
calculation.semantics: Force target lane/fixed-lane mode.
formulas: In fixed mode target lane is skill-specified while side movement is possible.
calculation.metric: Recorded lane displacement/direction and blocked/clear opportunities.
limitations: No standalone forward term at fixed recorded context.
Alternate escape/field response cannot be recovered.

calculation.name: Random gold activation
calculation.semantics: Activate a random selection of pending gold skills.
formulas: Select up to declared count from eligible pending gold/evolution skills.
calculation.metric: Requested count and recorded same-frame gold candidates; successful skills analyzed separately.
limitations: No invented chosen-child link from nearby events.
Do not double-count the parent and its child skill effects.

calculation.name: Carnival legacy bonus
calculation.semantics: Native enum ChallengeMatchBonus_Old; event-only legacy bonus.
calculation.metric: Declared legacy event bonus; calculation unavailable.
limitations: Enum identity is known; numeric event behavior is not recovered.
Raw1.0 is not a supported speed bonus.

calculation.metric: Conditional distribution, no per-race point.

calculation.metric: Verified count bounds, then verified Global formula.
limitations: Sparse order changes do not establish native pass triggers.

calculation.name: Fans
calculation.semantics: Scale with number of fans; native enum MultiplyFanCount.
calculation.metric: Resolved reference magnitude when captured fan count is known.
limitations: Thresholds are from the readable replay reference implementation, not native method-body verification.
Missing fan count remains unknown; no default maximum multiplier.

evidence.source: Bundled installed Global master skill_data and text_data categories47/48

calculation.name: Maximum raw stat
calculation.semantics: Scale with highest of five raw stats.
calculation.metric: Resolved magnitude with all five raw stats.
limitations: Use raw, not adjusted stats; missing raw inputs remain unknown.

calculation.name: Active green skills
calculation.semantics: Scale by activated tags601–615.
calculation.metric: Magnitude with exact tags and proven active passive branches.
limitations: All equipped green skills are not all active; absent tags or uncertain activation remain unknown.

calculation.name: Direct magnitude
calculation.semantics: Direct master value with effect-type level coefficient.
calculation.metric: Resolved magnitude.
limitations: Ordinary acquired skills have level1; missing unique/inherited level is unknown.

calculation.name: No additional activation
calculation.semantics: Apply effect at initial successful proc.
calculation.metric: Initial magnitude.

calculation.name: Additional overtake
calculation.semantics: Apply additional effect on passes while active, max3.
formulas: Effect begins after qualifying pass and lasts remaining active duration.
calculation.metric: Bounded additional-effect intervals.
limitations: Must not apply additional magnitude at initial proc; sampled crossings do not establish every native qualifying pass.

calculation.name: Additional skill, max3
calculation.semantics: Apply after other successful skill notifications while active.
calculation.metric: Event-supported extra magnitude intervals.
limitations: Initial proc itself is not an additional trigger; sparse/transient semantics stay bounded.

calculation.name: Additional skill, max2
calculation.semantics: Apply after other successful skill notifications while active.
calculation.metric: Event-supported extra magnitude intervals.
limitations: Do not promote all nearby events to native additional effects.

calculation.name: Direct duration
calculation.semantics: Base duration scaled by course distance.
calculation.metric: Reported duration preferred; supported reference fallback.
limitations: Instant/passive effects do not use a timed duration.

calculation.name: Leader gap duration
calculation.semantics: Scale by gap to first place at activation.
calculation.metric: Reported duration or reference duration from interpolated leader gap.
requirements: Complete supported leader/self positions at proc
limitations: Interpolated sampled positions are not exact native frame positions.

calculation.name: HP duration
calculation.semantics: Scale by HP at activation.
calculation.metric: Reported duration or supported same-tier HP duration.
requirements: Bracketing HP samples in the same tier
limitations: Shared/sparse recovery brackets may cross tiers; reported duration preferred.

calculation.name: Overtake duration
calculation.semantics: Extend while active for successful passes, max3.
calculation.metric: Reported expiry or conditional sampled-crossing extension.
limitations: Sampled crossings are reference pass candidates, not recovered native overtake notifications.
Sparse samples can omit passes and cannot establish exact expiry.
